message: 雌株ＤＡハー！

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Just as expected of the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Today is Culture Day, so the academy's closed. And this hill has a great view... Which means you're planning to laugh at them, right, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「That wouldn't be funny at all」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't you gonna spot some idiot who forgot it's a holiday and came to school anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't do something so twisted!」

name: Synn
message: 「From up here, you can see the whole Ryuusei Academy, right? I want to look at the building layout while thinking up decorations for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Synn
message: 「Where people who enter through the school gate will walk, and how they'll move through...」

name: Synn
message: 「Which spots should have elaborate illuminations to really boost the Christmas mood...」

name: Misa
message: 「From here, we can look out over Ryuusei Academy. Shio, you have sharp eyes for distance, don't you?」

name: Shio
message: 「Naturally!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh?」
Surprisingly, someone was already here. Standing at the spot overlooking the academy's facilities were Misa and Shio-chan.

name: Misa
message: 「You understand, right? Don't let your guard down, okay?」

name: Shio
message: 「Foolish question!」
The two of them are observing the grounds below with incredible concentration and haven't noticed that I've arrived.
I see, so Misa came up here to work out ideas for the Holy Night Festival too... Having such a dependable vice president makes me a lucky guy.

name: Misa
message: 「Ginkgo trees have both female and male trees. You know that, right? The important ones are the female trees」

name: Shio
message: 「Common sense!」
...Ginkgo?

name: Misa
message: 「Judging by the ginkgo trees at Asukai Shrine, the ginkgo nuts should start falling around November 20th」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood!」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm... What connection do ginkgo trees and ginkgo nuts have with the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-S-S-Sakura-kun!? Since when have you been standing there! You got careless, Shio!」

name: Shio
message: 「S-S-S-Sister, the likelihood of our stratagem failing has grown immense!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you so flustered?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, I am not flustered at all! I am always majestic and composed. That is precisely the quality required of a Student Council President!」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Sister, our secret has been discovered! O-Our hard-won backup plan may come to naught!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Shio, please don't panic」

name: Shio
message: 「I refuse to suffer another blunder this autumn as well!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but if it's bad for me to be around, I can step away?」

name: Shio
message: 「N-Nay! Lord Synn is a trustworthy person! It is just, well... that spirit...」

name: Paqy
message: 「What about yours truly?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, do you happen to know that many ginkgo trees grow along the approach to Asukai Shrine?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course」

name: Shio
message: 「Within the sacred precincts of Asukai, all hunting and gathering is strictly forbidden... However, only acorns and ginkgo nuts are specially permitted」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's great. Kids need acorns, and picking ginkgo nuts makes adults happy too」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. However...」

name: Misa
message: 「Last autumn, you see, someone went and took every last ginkgo nut」

name: Synn
message: 「That's going too far. Even if it's permitted, there should be a limit」

name: Shio
message: 「Precisely, as a shrine maiden I cannot overlook it. Judging by the methods, it was the work of a professional... Likely a catering company」

name: Shio
message: 「This year, I intend to beat the culprit to the punch by collecting all the ginkgo nuts not only at our shrine, but across the entire surrounding area as a warning!」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, that's why we came up to this hill. Looking out over Ryuusei Town from here, it's obvious at a glance where the ginkgo trees are growing」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Got it. I won't tell anyone about your and Shio-chan's plan. I promise」

name: Shio
message: 「I trusted that Lord Synn would keep it a secret. However, that spirit...」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, don't worry. Paqy is actually really loyal despite how he looks」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly ain't interested. Telling someone would be too much of a pain anyway」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehe, oh, Paqy-san」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, you're surprisingly perceptive, Sakura-kun. I suppose I can give you a little more credit」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there are things I don't get, you know? Why are you two wearing your uniforms? Even though today's a holiday」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me? I can't hear you」

name: Shio
message: 「How shameful. We mistook today for a school day」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shio! Don't answer him with such stupid honesty!!」

name: Shio
message: 「B-But since it had been so long since we sisters came to school together,」

name: Shio
message: 「You were the one who said, 'It would be a waste to just go home like this. Since we're already here, let's take a stroll around the campus,' were you not, Elder Sister?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, that was a joke! Shh! Shhhhhh!!」

name: Misa
message: 「M-More importantly, Sakura-kun, why did you come up here?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn was overlooking the academy, carefully pondering the arrangements for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Synn
message: 「Wrong, I was looking for a dummy who'd get confused and come to school on a holiday」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku...」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ngggh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Nuggggh...」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn. Care to cross blades with this humble one?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way」

name: Shio
message: 「How strange, I cannot hear you at all」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio. Show Sakura-kun the mercy of the Asukai family's enshrined deity, Fujitakanasumi-no-Mikoto」

name: Shio
message: 「As you command!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaaaahhhhhhh!!」
